title: Cap. IV Arg. 8: from the order of execution — whom God saves/destroys in time he decreed from eternity
pass_a_gloss: Argument 8. From the order of execution they dispute thus; Those and such as God in time saves and destroys, those and such he decreed from eternity to save and to destroy: But God saves in time only those persevering in faith, as such; he destroys unbelievers, as such: Therefore God from eternity decreed to save only the faithful, as such. They prove the Major from the immutability of God: the Minor from the perpetual voice of the Gospel, which promises life to believers, threatens death to unbelievers.
pass_b_english: Arg. 8. From the order of execution they argue: those and such as God saves and destroys in time, he decreed from eternity to save and destroy. But in time God saves only those who persevere in faith, as such, and destroys unbelievers as such. Therefore from eternity he decreed to save only the faithful as such. They prove the Major from God's immutability; the Minor from the Gospel's standing voice — life promised to believers, death threatened to unbelievers.
source_text: Arg. 8. Ab ordine exsecutionis sic disputant; Illi et tales quos et quales Deus in tempore salvat et perdit, illos et tales ab aeterno decrevit salvare et perdere: Atqui Deus solos perseverantes in fide, qua tales, in tempore salvat; incredulos, qua tales, perdit: Ergo Deus ab aeterno decrevit solos fideles, qua tales, salvare. Majorem probant ab immutabilitate Dei: Minorem ex perpetua voce Evangelii, quod credentibus vitam pollicetur, incredulis mortem interminatur.
